---
name: Browser engine verification
about: Share reproducible compatibility or privacy-policy measurements.
title: "[Engine]: "
---

### Engine and binary

Camoufox / CloakBrowser / Glint; engine version, CamouFlow version/commit,
OS and binary source. For an own build, include public revision/patch names.

### Measurement

Public or controlled test page, exact configuration and reproduction steps.
State the expected result and what actually happened; include sanitized evidence.

### Controls and limitations

Compare the unmodified/default configuration where possible. Note repeated runs,
document/iframe/worker scope and anything untested. A detection-site score alone
does not prove undetectability or CAPTCHA reliability.

Do not attach secrets, cookies, profile archives or host IP addresses.
Security vulnerabilities belong in private reporting, not this template.
